propositions: Whole-tree checkout fixtures export 3,019 files when only hatch_build.py, pyproject.toml, and src/rebar/__init__.py are consumed by the production hook, causing unnecessary build repetition and session fixture initialization across xdist workers.

The artifact-probe workflow uses GITHUB_SHA instead of deriving final checkout HEAD via git rev-parse --short HEAD, allowing wrong nonempty SHA values to pass truthiness-only assertions and violate exact-source identity requirements.
Xdist runtime assigns three built_artifacts consumers to separate workers, each independently initializing the full-tree session fixture with 6.60–6.74s setup overhead per worker.

Local profiling shows full python -m build costs 3.85–4.32s and git add costs 1.37–1.53s per fallback, while the same production hook on a minimal three-file committed package preserves exact SHA while reducing paired totals from 6.30/9.26s to 2.66/5.43s.
Both artifact workflow lanes must derive expected SHA using git rev-parse --short HEAD after final checkout and require exact equality assertions for installed wheel and sdist provenance.
